validation.metal_summary_fixture: overlap union, PID isolation, shared encoder and byte units passed

protocol: CPU samples are 60 seconds each, with Animation menu tracking; both variants use the same final GLB/JSON and same maximized native window. GPU tracing did not run in these CPU intervals.

Before and final: autonomous district animation; rotation final: same district plus auto-rotate. Autonomous animation is now capped at 60 renders/s, input and rotation retain display cadence. Host clock advances on every display callback, so actor speed is unchanged.
State-elision-only measurement showed 23.20% vs 23.73%; no substantial per-frame CPU improvement is claimed. The main saving is cadence, not reduced scene complexity.

GPU traces requested 8s before and 3s after/rotation; exported activity windows include instrument startup/tail. GPU active percent is the union of target PID Active intervals, not whole-device utilization. Render-pass spans include gaps between vertex and fragment; pass frequency is not presented FPS.
Metal memory is MTLDevice.currentAllocatedSize from xctrace. It is unified memory and overlaps process footprint.
GPU per-pass spans vary across short traces. No GPU per-frame speedup is claimed.
Initial blank/occluded native baseline (1.17% CPU) is excluded. A zoom/resize restored actual visible drawing before the reported measurements.
Three-dimensional detail, indexed geometry, GPU skin/morph, resolution and MSAA are retained. Actor count increased from 28 to 32 to add alley traffic.
Other worktree WIP was preserved. No commit made.
